what: a seeded body `match r { Ok(v) => .., Err(()) => 0 }` said E0423 "found `Error`": core's Result cell was frozen without its Ok/Err ctor fn heads, so the seeded store's fn_sig(Ok) was None and the pattern's FnDef printed as the portable Error node
cost: about 20 minutes of reading: the message `found `Error`` reads like a name, but it is PNode::Error's Debug in check.rs ty_shown
cause: want_heads found an ADT's ctors by key origin (Origin::Member), which only a struct's ctor has; an enum variant's ctor key is checker_of(its library key) and no origin names it
whys: two ways to name one ctor (member key for a struct, library key prefix for a variant); the search used one
class: a record's member list derived from a side index (key origins) instead of the row that owns them
prevention: done: ctors come from the ADT row's own variant keys; test head_tests.rs a_seeded_store_answers_every_ctor_lookup_as_lowering; BZFZ 4
annoyance: a type that is not portable is shown as `Error` in a diagnostic's found text, which hides what it was (a FnDef)
workaround: read check.rs ty_shown before trusting a `found` word
